陆染离开后，林舒回到了自己的房间。

这时候，他才看清楚了手里的东西。

那是一个普普通通的三角祥符，用黄色符纸叠成，隐约可以看到上面写着“雨渐耳”的紫薇大帝讳。

从形制上来看，这似乎是再常见不过的护身符。

类似的护身符在各种道观里十块钱就能买一张，唯一的作用不过就是提供心理安慰罢了。

但陆染把这东西给自己的时候却说，这东西是他们所掌握的为数不多的“仪轨造物”之一。

并且，她还信誓旦旦地说，它在关键时刻能救自己一命。

有那么强？

林舒翻来覆去地看着手里的平安符，无论怎么看，它也就是一个普普通通的平安符而已。

仪轨造物.......

类似于......蛇？

本质上来说，蛇也是一种仪轨造物。

只要完成一套完整的仪轨，就可以不需要任何前置条件地随意发动。

那理论上，这个平安符也可以随意发动吧？

应该怎么做？

林舒试探着闭上眼睛，想像那些电影里的道士一样去感受平安符里“能量”的流动。

但很可惜，这样的尝试根本没有任何结果。

不是，这玩意儿到底有没有用啊？！

算了，不管有没有用，先收好再说。

林舒把平安符好好收在了口袋里贴身藏好，正打算上床睡觉，但也就在这时，他的心里突然冒出来一个想法。

平安符是保平安的。

师刀坛也是保平安的。

那这两者.....

本质上不是同一种仪轨吗？！

这两者，会不会存在什么共同点？

如果能把其中的共同点筛选出来，是不是就有可能补完原本并不完整的师刀坛仪轨？

林舒瞬间来了兴趣，犹豫了片刻，他拿出手机，找到了之前刚刚加上的秦朗的微信。

“我收到陆染给我的平安符了。”

“我想问问，这玩意儿的制法你们那里有吗？”

发完消息，林舒略有些紧张地盯着屏幕，等待着秦朗的回复。

他其实并不确定对方会不会回复自己，毕竟一套“经验”的仪轨，无论对哪个势力来说都是一种宝贵的财富。

按道理来说，他们是没理由随便把仪轨交给外人的。

哪怕自己现在跟他们是一条船上的人，但也不过是刚刚上船而已，信任度远远不够。

After Lu Ran left, Lin Shu returned to his room.

Only then did he see clearly what was in his hand.

It was an ordinary triangular auspicious talisman, made of yellow talisman paper. You could vaguely see the Ziwei Emperor taboo that read "Rain gradually ears" on it.

Judging from the shape, this seems to be a very common amulet.

Similar amulets can be bought in various Taoist temples for ten yuan, and their only function is to provide psychological comfort.

But when Lu Ran gave this thing to himself, he said that this thing was one of the few "ritual creations" they had.

Moreover, she swore that it could save her life at a critical moment.

Is it that strong?

Lin Shu looked over and over at the peace talisman in his hand. No matter how he looked at it, it was just an ordinary peace talisman.

Ritual Creation......

Something like...a snake?

In essence, snakes are also ritual creatures.

As long as you complete a complete set of rituals, you can activate it at will without any prerequisites.

In theory, this peace talisman can be activated at will, right?

What should be done?

Lin Shu tentatively closed his eyes and imagined feeling the flow of "energy" in the peace charm like the Taoist priests in those movies.

But alas, such an attempt yielded no results at all.

No, is this thing useful?!

Forget it, regardless of whether it is useful or not, put it away first.

Lin Shu put the peace charm in his pocket and hid it close to his body, and was about to go to bed, but at this moment, an idea suddenly came to his mind.

The peace talisman keeps peace.

The Master Sword Altar also ensures peace.

Then these two...

Isn’t it essentially the same ritual?!

Do the two have anything in common?

If the commonalities among them could be screened out, would it be possible to complete the originally incomplete Master Sword Altar ritual?

Lin Shu was instantly interested. After hesitating for a moment, he took out his phone and found Qin Lang's WeChat account that he had just added before.

"I received the peace charm Lu Ran gave me."

"I want to ask, do you have the recipe for making this stuff?"

After sending the message, Lin Shu stared at the screen nervously, waiting for Qin Lang's reply.

He was actually not sure whether the other party would reply to him. After all, a set of "experience" rituals was a valuable asset to any force.

Logically speaking, there is no reason for them to hand over rituals to outsiders casually.

Even though he is on the same boat as them now, he has only just boarded the boat and his trust level is far from enough.
